# Geyser / Mojang source notice

The versioned Java 26.3 snapshot combines:

- Java state names, properties, registry IDs, defaults and version metadata generated locally by the official Mojang Java 26.3 server data generator.
- Java-to-Bedrock primary block mappings from GeyserMC/mappings, validated against the corresponding GeyserMC/mappings-generator full release's named debug mapping.

Exact URLs, revisions and SHA-256 checksums are embedded in `presets/java/v26_3/catalog.json.gz` and recorded in `third_party/gen_resource/geyser/versions/26.3.lock.json`.
